trigger_condition.shape_trigger: 3D input tensor, e.g. shape (N, C, L), made non-contiguous by dimension permutation
trigger_condition.memory_trigger: Non-contiguous tensor produced by permute, transpose, or slicing
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input tensor shape (2500, 4, 100) produced from torch.rand(2500, 100, 4).permute(0, 2, 1); F.max_pool1d(input, kernel_size=1).

bug_oracle.description: Segfault when calling max_pool1d on a non-contiguous 3D tensor.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate non-contiguous inputs by applying permute, transpose, or slicing to contiguous tensors.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct 3D random tensors and then permute dimensions to produce non-contiguous layouts with varying shapes.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Vary pool kernel_size, stride, padding, and input contiguity; include kernel_size=1.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Create tensor -> apply layout-changing operation -> call torch.nn.functional.max_pool1d -> observe process.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Monitor for process crash/SIGSEGV; compare outputs or completion against contiguous baseline.
